_README: STAGED hooks.json config fragment — NOT merged into live ~/.cursor/hooks.json. Shows the exact per-script config that MUST accompany wiring the open-door shell/MCP hooks. Research §4: hooks are FAIL-OPEN unless failClosed:true — any deny that matters (git push, secrets, Red core) evaporates on a script error without this. beforeReadFile is left WITHOUT failClosed on purpose (nudge-only; the real read boundary is .cursorignore, research R2).

beforeShellExecution._note: failClosed:true => if the wrapper crashes/times-out/emits bad JSON, the shell call is DENIED, not allowed. The wrapper's door-scope path stays fail-open internally (never wedge on a scope miss); only the hard-deny CORE (secrets/git-push/Red) benefits from failClosed.

beforeMCPExecution._note: RECOMMENDED addition (not staged in Phase 1): mirror the shell adapter for MCP tool calls so credential-broker / ledger tools are gated fail-closed. Add when an MCP door-check wrapper is authored.

beforeReadFile._note: NO failClosed — nudge/telemetry only. beforeReadFile deny is unreliable (research §1); the read boundary is .cursorignore + sandbox protected paths, not this hook.
